title: IRLBench: A Multi-modal, Culturally Grounded, Parallel Irish-English Benchmark for Open-Ended LLM Reasoning Evaluation

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the performance disparity (accuracy gap) and language fidelity of LLMs when responding to parallel open-ended academic questions in a high-resource language (English) versus an extremely low-resource language (Irish).

Evaluating models on a culturally grounded dataset derived directly from local educational materials (2024 Irish Leaving Certificate exams) to mitigate and reveal limitations compared to US-centric translated benchmarks.
